links.outcome: Composite score of advanced LLMs versus GPT-4o baseline on the same cases
links.effect: Multi-modal arm: Grok 4.1 15.06 ± 0.68, GPT 5.1 Thinking 14.52 ± 1.19, Gemini 2.5 Pro 14.30 ± 1.08 versus GPT-4o 11.20 ± 0.72.
links.quote: Grok 4.1 led with the highest overall score in the multi-modal arm (15.06 ± 0.68), followed by GPT 5.1 Thinking (14.52 ± 1.19) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (14.30 ± 1.08), while GPT-4o lagged significantly at 11.20 ± 0.72.

links.outcome: Rate of major harmful responses by model in tele-consultation cases
links.effect: Major harmful responses: Grok 4.1 4%, GPT 5.1 Thinking 8%, Gemini 2.5 Pro 10%, GPT-4o 16%.
links.quote: Regarding safety, advanced models exhibited markedly fewer major harmful responses (Grok 4.1: 4%; GPT 5.1 Thinking: 8%; Gemini 2.5 Pro: 10%) compared to GPT-4o (16%).

unlisted_practices: Adding parent-taken mobile photographs (multi-modal input) to text improves LLM safety and communication quality

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy, safety, and communication quality of multiple multimodal LLMs on 50 real-world tele-ophthalmology cases with expert clinician grading; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
